'''Ubese boots''' were footwear that the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] used in conjunction with their [[Ubese raider armor|armor]]. The boots where rugged and equipped with tight padding, perfectly suited for [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. They offered protection from attacks aimed at the lower legs.
